FRESHMAN ADMISSION: ALS (ALTERNATIVE LEARNING SYSTEM) APPLICANTS
Source: note by the ontology maintainer; no ALS information appears in the Citizen's Charter, Admission Guidelines or Handbook.
The sources used for this assistant do not describe a separate route, document list or GWA rule for ALS applicants, so no ALS-specific rules can be stated.
What is documented for new freshmen: a report card (DepEd Form 138) or its equivalent (Form 137), good moral certificate, medical and other documents, the entrance examination and the interview, and the program's minimum GWA.
Ask the Guidance Office (entrance exam) or the Office of the Registrar which document takes the place of the report card for ALS applicants.

h:additionalInfo: CTE programs also need no grade below 85 in English, Math and Science, and CCS gives priority to STEM and ICT applicants.
h:additionalInfo: CTE programs also require no grade below 85 in English, Math and Science.
h:additionalInfo: Cutoffs for 1st Sem AY 2026-2027: GWA 85 for BS Information Technology (3 majors), BS Criminology and BS Hospitality Management; GWA 87 for BS Fisheries, BTLE and BTVTE; GWA 88 for BS Psychology, both BS Business Administration majors and BS Tourism Management; GWA 90 for Accountancy, Computer Science, Food Technology, Nutrition and Dietetics, Physical Education, all five BS Education majors and Elementary Education.
h:additionalInfo: Example: a GWA of 86 qualifies only for the GWA-85 programs.
h:additionalInfo: If your GWA is below the minimum for the program you want, you cannot be admitted to it; your only option is to choose another program with a lower cutoff.
h:additionalInfo: Meeting the cutoff is not enough by itself: applicants must still pass the entrance exam and interview.
h:additionalInfo: Minimum GWA cutoffs range from 85 to 90 depending on the program (LSPU Admission Guidelines, 1st Sem AY 2026-2027, Annex A). GWA 90: BS Accountancy, BS Computer Science, BS Food Technology, BS Nutrition and Dietetics, Bachelor of Physical Education, all five BS Education majors, and Bachelor of Elementary Education (11 programs). GWA 88: BS Psychology, both BS Business Administration majors, BS Tourism Management (4). GWA 87: BS Fisheries, BTLE, BTVTE (3). GWA 85: the three BS Information Technology majors, BS Criminology, BS Hospitality Management (5). Extra conditions: CTE programs require no grade lower than 85 in English, Mathematics, and Science; CCS gives priority to STEM and ICT/ICTS strand applicants.
h:additionalInfo: The GWA cutoff is strict.

trace.answer_for_eval:
Freshman applicants must submit the following documents:
1. Report card (DepEd Form 138) or its equivalent (Form 137)
2. Good moral certificate
3. Medical and other documents
4. Entrance examination
5. Interview
6. Program's minimum GWA
7. Photocopy of authenticated birth certificate (NSO)
8. Three latest 2x2 pictures

For ALS applicants, the required documents are similar, but it is advised to ask the Guidance Office or the Office of the Registrar to confirm which document takes the place of the report card.
